blocks.text: With the holiday tomorrow and most of us back in the office for the rest of the week, we are going to have lunch brought into the conference room on Thursday at noon, on the firm, and there is no agenda beyond getting everyone around one table for an hour, which we have not managed in some time.

So that the operations team can place the order on Wednesday afternoon, please reply to me by noon on Wednesday with (1) whether you will be there and (2) any dietary needs or allergies we should plan around, and if you are out of the office on Thursday, just say so and we will plan the next one with you in mind.
